The file [`/app/filter.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ji4oqo1s/filter.py) has been created to remove JavaScript from HTML files while strictly preserving legitimate HTML content, attributes, and formatting.

### Key Implementation Details
- **Command-line Interface:** Accepts the target HTML file path as `argv[1]` and modifies the file in-place, preserving character encoding (`utf-8`) and exact line endings (LF/CRLF).
- **Format Preservation:** Avoids AST/DOM re-serialization (which modifies whitespace, reorders attributes, alters tag syntax, and introduces boilerplate wrappers). Operates directly on the HTML document structure using token-based tag/attribute parsing to remove only dangerous substrings.
- **`<script>` Tag Removal:** Removes standard, multiline, mixed-case, self-closing (`<script ... />`), and unclosed `<script>` elements.
- **Inline Event Handler Stripping:** Removes all DOM event handlers matching `^on[a-zA-Z]` (e.g., `onclick`, `onload`, `onerror`, `onmouseover`) across all HTML and SVG elements, while preserving non-dangerous attributes (like `class`, `id`, `alt`, `title`, safe `href`/`src`, table properties, etc.).
- **Dangerous URL Scheme Removal:** Detects and strips `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, and malicious `data:` schemes (e.g. `data:text/javascript`, `data:text/html`), handling variations with mixed casing, leading/trailing whitespace, embedded tabs/newlines, and HTML entities (`j`, `:`, `	`).
- **Additional Attack Vectors Handled:** Removes `javascript:` URLs in CSS `<style>` blocks, `srcdoc` iframe attributes containing scripts/event handlers, and dangerous `meta` refresh URLs.

### Verification
- Tested in-place modification on full HTML5 pages, tables, forms, SVG images, and isolated snippets.
- Validated via headless Chromium (Selenium) to ensure that no script execution, alerts, or DOM modifications occur.
- Verified that legitimate structure (headers, table hierarchies, attributes, indentation, and Unicode characters) remains functional and byte-exact outside removed substrings.
